name: Tretch Craventail
canonNotes: A Skaven Warlord who rose from nothing through cunning and treachery, notorious for escaping any disaster.
Leads Clan Rictus from Crookback Mountain.
voiceNotes: Sly, cowardly and ingratiating; fawning to the strong, sneering to the weak.
Always looking for an angle or an exit.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
